task.property_text: RequestHandler.set_cookie never lets a caller-supplied value add or change cookie attributes.

property_clause.property: RequestHandler.set_cookie never lets a caller-supplied value add or change cookie attributes.

environment.scope: The tornadoweb/tornado library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.set_cookie(name: str, value: str, attributes=None) sets one cookie through Tornado's RequestHandler, importing tornado fresh. The verifier records an injection only when a caller-supplied value adds or changes a cookie attribute. A test that shows the failure calls set_cookie().
